name: The Ridge
description: A large open space in the heart of Shimla offering panoramic views of the surrounding mountains and hosting cultural events.

name: Jakhoo Temple
description: An ancient temple dedicated to Lord Hanuman, perched atop Jakhoo Hill with stunning views and a giant Hanuman statue.

name: Christ Church
description: The second oldest church in North India, known for its neo-Gothic architecture and beautiful stained glass windows.

name: Kufri
description: A popular hill station near Shimla famous for skiing, tobogganing, and panoramic Himalayan views.

name: Shimla State Museum
description: Showcases Himachal Pradesh's rich cultural heritage through traditional arts, crafts, and historical artifacts.

name: Annandale Ground
description: A scenic flat ground surrounded by pine trees, used for army training and adventure sports like golf and horse riding.

name: Tara Devi Temple
description: A serene hilltop temple dedicated to Goddess Tara, offering peaceful surroundings and breathtaking views of Shimla.

name: Summer Hill
description: A quiet and less crowded hill station area with lush greenery, perfect for nature walks and bird watching.

name: Lakkar Bazaar
description: A vibrant local market famous for wooden handicrafts, souvenirs, and traditional Himachali items.

name: Scandal Point
description: A famous meeting point and shopping area with a fascinating history and stunning views of the valley.

name: Indian Institute of Advanced Study
description: A majestic colonial-era building set in beautiful gardens, now a research institute with guided tours available.

name: Gaiety Theatre
description: A historic Victorian-style theatre hosting plays, cultural events, and exhibitions in Shimla.

name: Chadwick Falls
description: A hidden gem waterfall surrounded by dense forest, ideal for trekking and nature photography.

name: Annandale Golf Course
description: A scenic golf course set in a valley surrounded by pine trees, offering a unique sporting experience in Shimla.

name: Summer Hill Railway Station
description: A quaint station on the Kalka-Shimla toy train route, surrounded by lush hills and a great spot for photography.

name: Mall Road
description: The bustling main street of Shimla lined with shops, cafes, and colonial architecture, perfect for shopping and dining.

name: Tattapani Hot Springs
description: Natural hot water springs believed to have medicinal properties, set in a scenic riverside location near Shimla.

name: Naldehra Golf Course
description: One of the oldest natural golf courses in India, surrounded by dense deodar forests and rolling hills.

name: Summer Hill Trek
description: A scenic trek through pine forests and quaint villages offering spectacular views of Shimla and the Himalayas.

name: Annandale Army Museum
description: A small museum showcasing military history and artifacts, located within the Annandale cantonment area.
